audit.whatIsWrong: Enemy misgendered in a dozen fields; cooldowns field had no digit; Shockwave's actual numbers (110s rank 1, 410 range from ball) and the E-shield trade-window never stated.
audit.why: Orianna is she/her. Kit: R 110/95/80 at 410 range from ball, E shield 9s CD, Q 7/6/5/4/3 at 815 range. Both TF Q and her Q are projectiles.
R 110/95/80, E 9s are the punishable timers.
Common-mistakes entries are behavioural, no elo tiers.
